subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw change gateway-host exec private-LAN reachability semantics?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the missing diagnostic, but allowing or intentionally blocking private-LAN exec traffic is a security and product-policy choice.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving broader private-network access policy to the related security trackers.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent parity as the product goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer To Broader Trackers
options.body: Reject the diagnostic-only scope and track this behavior only under the existing private-network policy issues.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving broader private-network access policy to the related security trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: Exec host routing, outcome formatting, docs, and security-boundary history most consistently route through this owner signal.
